payload.summary: What nahel already has toward ask-about-a-command: COMMANDS registry in src/cli.ts carries a one-line description per verb (renders in nahel help); workflow frontmatter carries name/description/args (renders in shims); AGENTS.md orientation section (src/templates/agents.ts) teaches rules-of-the-road but NOT verb routing or vocabulary; brief workflow onboards onto a store, not onto the tool. Prior art warning swtjwzv5/swtjwvz5: workflow docs once shipped born-broken examples (log --data body= vs reserved keys) because nothing scanned docs against the CLI — doc-vs-code drift has already bitten once, arguing for generated-or-tested docs, not hand-maintained prose. Roadmap node subcommand-help already commits to --help exit 0 per verb, self-describing from the top down.
